text: hand (terminal) uses submodules external/toe (VT engine), external/mayag (GPU UI), external/mayag/third_party/jaal (runtime) — all are the user's own projects; fix bugs/add API directly in them when needed, keeping app→mayag→jaal layering strict.
hand's UI must look premium and polished (the coolest-looking terminal, never toyish): restrained palette, precise spacing/typography, subtle depth/motion, fully GUI-customizable.

In hand, everything visible must be a widget: view() only composes widgets (hand/widget/*.hpp following mayag control conventions — props struct, id, ControlContext, look from theme); no ad-hoc layout in the app.
